title: Common Element Relay
description: Given two integer arrays, print all distinct values that occur in both arrays in increasing order. If there is no common value, print -1.
inputFormat: First line: n and m. Second line: n integers. Third line: m integers.
outputFormat: Print the distinct common values in increasing order separated by spaces, or -1 if none exist.
hints: Store one array in a set, collect matching values from the other array, then sort the result.

examples.explanation: The arrays contain no common value.
